subject: Closure playbook & MAP — FinSecure evaluation, pricing for compliance add-ons

Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@finsecure.com>

Subject: MAP proposal: evaluation plan + compliance add-on pricing

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (FinSecure_MAP_v3.docx) that lays out a 6-week evaluation, pilot commitments, and a proposed close timeline. The doc includes a dedicated section on compliance add-ons (audit logs, retention, premium controls) and a pricing appendix.

Key ask: can you confirm procurement/legal availability the week of Jun 8 so we can finalize commercial terms and DocuSign the SOW by Jun 18? Hitting that cadence lets us reserve Dedicated capacity for your pilot in our June window.

Summary (high level):
- Week 1–2: sandbox evaluation (Redwood hosted) — success criteria: latency < 250ms p95, acceptable token cost during 2k QPS synthetic workload
- Week 3–4: pilot (sandbox -> reserved dev capacity) — data isolation, audit log enabled (30d by default)
- Week 5–6: ramp & contract execution — commit options discussed below

Compliance add-ons called out in the doc: audit log export (streaming and S3 retention), extended retention tiers (90/365 days), premium access controls (per-tenant RBAC + SIEM integration). I pulled initial price estimates into pricing-breakdown-commitments.xlsx.

I've CC'd Tom so he can loop in procurement if needed. If you want an adjusted MAP cadence or different success criteria, happy to update.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-05-24T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: FW: FinSecure — pricing & retention asks (procurement attached)

Team — forwarding FinSecure's questions. Procurement explicitly asked for: feature-level pricing (one-time vs recurring), 365-day retention path with KMS details, and how pilot credits apply to committed discounts. Can you review the attached questionnaire and the MAP and weigh in?

Below is the quick pricing outline I drafted for the customer — please comment inline or reply-all with edits:

Proposed compliance add-on pricing (draft):
- Audit Logs (Basic stream & S3 export): $400/month (recurring) — includes 30-day retention, daily exports, CSV + JSON formats
- Audit Logs (Advanced with SIEM/Syslog): $1,200/month (recurring) — adds streaming to customer SIEM, schema mapping, 24/7 alert hooks
- Retention tiers (S3 copy & vaulting, per-GB/month):
  * 30 days: included
  * 90 days: $0.02/GB/month
  * 365 days: $0.08/GB/month + one-time vaulting setup fee $2,500 (for encryption/KMS integration)
- Premium Controls (per-tenant RBAC, API key rotation tooling, audit access control): one-time configuration $7,500 + $600/month for ongoing entitlement management
- SOC2 artifacts and on-demand evidence access: $1,500/year (attestation + access portal)

Commit/discount structure (draft):
- No commit (consumption): list price
- Pilot (3 months): $10k in platform credits applied to first invoice if converted to >=12-month commit within 30 days after pilot
- 12-month commit (committed spend >= $250k/year): 20% discount on per-token rates + 10% off recurring add-ons
- 24-month commit: 28% discount + priority capacity + extended SLA credits

SLA credit notes: we can offer up to 5% monthly credit for P95 violations; extended SLA options available at enterprise tier.

Questions for product/legal: is the $2,500 KMS integration one-time sufficient or are there expected additional engineering hours for FinSecure's on-prem key policies?

Rachel

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-25T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: FinSecure — pricing & retention asks (procurement attached)

All — quick notes from pricing ops/product POV:

- Retention: $2,500 onboarding for KMS integration is acceptable as an initial line item, but we should include 8–12 estimated eng hours at $250/hr if they require custom key policies or hardware HSM coordination. Call that out as an "engineering contingency" in the SOW.
- 365-day retention pricing at $0.08/GB/month looks good but add a minimum egress/export fee ($150) for ad-hoc bulk exports to cover S3 transfer or egress patterns.
- For commits: make the pilot-credit conditional: credits apply only if conversion to >=12-month commit within 30 days; credits are applied pro-rata to first 2 invoices. This prevents extended credit gaming.
- Discounts: agree to 20% at $250k ARR floor, but add clear quarterly ramp milestones in the MAP so both sides can baseline usage (example: 0–3 months <50k tokens/day; 3–6 months 50–250k tokens/day).

I can draft a short SOW appendix with line-items and contingency language if Rachel OKs.

—Ben
Customer Success / Pricing Ops

Agreed MAP & timeline (condensed):

  • Pilot (reserved dev capacity): Jun 15–Jul 15 — enable Audit Logs (Advanced) and 365-day retention for RegFund A
  • Ramp & contract signature: must-sign by Jun 18 to start committed billing from Jul 1 for reserved capacity

Commercial summary (headline):
- Pilot credits: $10,000 applied to invoice if conversion to 12-month commit (>= $250k ARR) occurs within 30 days after pilot end
- 12-month commit (>= $250k/year): 20% discount on per-token gen rates; 10% off recurring compliance add-ons
- Compliance add-ons (final):
  • Audit Logs (Advanced): $1,200/month (recurring) — streaming + SIEM hooks
  • 365-day retention: $0.08/GB/month + one-time KMS/vault setup $2,500 + engineering contingency estimate $2,000 (if custom work needed)
  • Premium Controls: one-time $7,500 + $600/month
  • SOC2 artifacts access: $1,500/year
  • Bulk export fee: $150 per export request (covers egress operations)

SOW next steps:
1) Rachel to issue Order Form + SOW (DocuSign link below) with line items and the engineering contingency bucket called out as optional additional work.
2) Procurement review and sign by Jun 18 to lock dedicated pilot capacity.
3) Kickoff call scheduled Jul 2 for onboarding and key exchange.
